fit.set: data/manifests/decision-p2b-jevstyle-dev.jsonl (150 authored JevBench-style items, no JevBench items)
fit.method: single temperature by NLL, applied to every (type, option-count) bucket
fit.note: the pod's held-out-domain fold (accuracy ~85%) under-corrects on JevBench hard (accuracy ~68%); offsets left at 0 pending the off-distribution (MMLU/irrelevance) check; 2026-09-24: written out for every (type, option-count) bucket, because the server serves any bucket missing from the file uncalibrated (T=1)
fit.counts_note: one temperature fitted on all 150 dev items and applied to every bucket, so every bucket's count is the size of that fit set
